records.title: Social Science Theory in Context
records.header: ISS 301 Social Science Theory in Context (5) SSc
records.text: ISS 301 Social Science Theory in Context (5) SSc Provides an introduction to the concepts of social theory, interdisciplinarity, and the thematic areas of the integrated social sciences major. Explores how social sciences study what people do, how people understand their world, and how that understanding shapes social practice. Offered: ASp.

records.title: Survey of Social Science Methods
records.header: ISS 302 Survey of Social Science Methods (5) SSc
records.text: ISS 302 Survey of Social Science Methods (5) SSc Provides an inclusive survey of methods used across the social sciences. Introduces statistics, survey research, and data visualization techniques. Also covers qualitative research methods ranging from participant observation to archival textual analysis. Students develop skills in both quantitative and qualitative reasoning using real-world evidence. Offered: A.
